definition: Why a diagram further down the ranked pool was not placed: the time the set was given ran out before the composer could place it. It is named; nobody placed it, so it is neither refused nor offered.
more: The other reason a diagram can go unreached is the pool-fill's own limit on how many it places past the set. The two are said apart, because a set stopped by its limit had time left and a set stopped by its time did not.
basis: Our wording of the pool-fill's time bound. build/compose.py, the bounds that stop the pool-fill: "the set's time ran out (fewer than five seconds left) before the next placement"; and "diagrams were placed from the pool, with time left" for the other bound.
